parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (1-128 printable ASCII characters), one per logical submit; a retry reuses it. A repeat of the same request replays the first response with the header Idempotency-Replayed: true when that response is final for the request: a 2xx, or a refusal that is a function of the request alone. A refusal that depends on state another request can change is not stored and the key is released, so a retry under the same key runs again (with another body it is a new request). These problem types are not stored and release the key: not-found, illegal-transition, concurrent-update, incomplete-operational-profile, serving-station-not-allowed, lane-endpoint-not-active, duplicate-lane, not-a-delivery-station, handoff-node-not-usable, unknown-region. A 5xx is never stored. While a key holds a stored answer, the same key with another method, path or body is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A missing key is 400 idempotency-key-required, a malformed one 400 idempotency-key-invalid. Keys are kept for 24 hours. vendor-connectivity sends its transactionId.
